===== src/buster/lib/compiler/frontend/c/c_source.c =====

     1: // Source loading, lexing, and preprocessing — the first stage of the
     2: // frontend, entered through c_preprocess near the bottom of the file. It
     3: // turns a root file into the flat CToken stream every later stage walks:
     4: // translation (line splices and carriage returns folded out), lexing,
     5: // directive handling, include resolution (real files and the builtin
     6: // resource headers), macro expansion, and the source metrics behind the
     7: // SOURCE table. c_prewarm at the bottom fills the lazily built tables on
     8: // one thread before any parallel phase reads them (AGENTS.md).
     9: //
    10: // Layout, in file order; each anchor is a definition to search for:
    11: //   c_space_local .. c_space_retoken           spelling spaces: append-only
    12: //                                              storage token spellings point
    13: //                                              into
    14: //   c_source_map_append, c_source_map_sort,    location checkpoints (see
    15: //   c_lex_token_location                       CTranslatedSource below)
    16: //   c_identifier_start ..                      character classes and the
    17: //   c_literal_plain_run_end                    prewarmed run tables
    18: //   c_translate_source                         phase-1/2 translation with
    19: //                                              SWAR/AVX-512/scalar variants
    20: //                                              kept in differential agreement
    21: //   c_source_metrics_add,                      the SOURCE table counters and
    22: //   c_source_metrics_file_row                  the per-file attribution rows
    23: //   c_lex_validate_word_utf8                   bounded word encoding checks
    24: //   c_lex_scan_one, c_lex_scalar               the scalar lexer
    25: //   c_lex_compact_tables_build,                the SIMD lexer (Validark
    26: //   c_lex_compact                              method, AGENTS.md): one
    27: //                                              window-wide class lookup
    28: //                                              (c_lex_byte_classes, authored
    29: //                                              from the scalar predicates
    30: //                                              above), the punctuator NFA and
    31: //                                              spelling tables, then the
    32: //                                              interleaved 16-row emitter;
    33: //                                              c_lex dispatches and
    34: //                                              c_lex_reference is the
    35: //                                              differential baseline
    36: //   CTokenStream, c_token_stream_reserve       final token rows plus the
    37: //                                              one-byte kind|punctuator
    38: //                                              sidecar consumed by parser
    39: //                                              shape walks
    40: //   c_macro_name_hash .. c_symbol_intern       macro and symbol tables
    41: //   c_macro_expansion_tasks_push ..            shared LIFO task batches,
    42: //   c_preprocess_expand                        arguments, stringify, paste,
    43: //                                              rescan and context floors
    44: //   CPpClassMasks, c_pp_class_masks_build,     the per-64-token class
    45: //   c_pp_line_end_masked,                      projection of a lexed run's
    46: //   c_pp_parenthesis_depth                     shape sidecar, and what the
    47: //                                              driver's per-line scans read
    48: //                                              instead of walking token rows
    49: //   c_conditional_* ,                          #if evaluation including
    50: //   c_integer_expression_evaluate              __has_* feature tests
    51: //   c_preprocess_pragma_*                      pragmas: once, pack, push/pop
    52: //   c_include_read .. c_include_name           include resolution and the
    53: //                                              builtin resource headers
    54: //   CIncludeGuardState, CIncludeFileTable      shared #import, #pragma once,
    55: //                                              and #ifndef guard identity
    56: //   c_preprocess_command_operations,           ordered command-line macro
    57: //   c_preprocess_define_directive              operations and shared #define
    58: //                                              parsing
    59: //   c_preprocess                               the stage driver
    60: //   c_prewarm                                  serial table prewarm
    61: 
    62: #include "c_internal.h"
    63: #include <buster/lib/compiler/frontend/c/c_source_internal.h>
    64: #include <buster/lib/compiler/frontend/c/c_source_metrics_internal.h>

    66: // Locations are recorded as checkpoints instead of one entry per translated
    67: // byte: within a run the original offset and the column both advance one per
    68: // output byte and the line is constant, so a checkpoint is needed only where
    69: // that linearity breaks — the byte after a newline and the byte after a line
    70: // splice. This is what keeps the lexer from writing a location for every
    71: // byte of every include it translates, and what lets tokens drop their eager
    72: // location entirely: a token's line/column recover on demand from its offset
    73: // through these checkpoints.
    74: typedef struct CTranslatedSource CTranslatedSource;
    75: struct CTranslatedSource
    76: {
    77:     String8 source;
    78:     IrSourceCheckpoint* checkpoints;
    79:     u32* checkpoint_offsets;
    80:     u32* checkpoint_pages;
    81:     u32 checkpoint_page_count;
    82:     u32 checkpoint_count;
    83:     // Spelling-space offset of source.pointer (0 without a space).
    84:     u32 translated_offset;
    85:     // Physical lines of the untranslated file, spliced ones included. The
    86:     // line counter the checkpoints already need makes this free.
    87:     u32 raw_lines;
    88: };
    89: 
    90: // The single contiguous byte space every token offset of one preprocess run
    91: // points into. All spelling bytes — the prelude, every translated include,
    92: // and every synthesized spelling (stringify, paste, builtins, expansion
    93: // copies) — are bump-allocated here so a spelling is always
    94: // `base + token.offset`, one add on the hot paths. The block is carved from
    95: // the caller's arena once; untouched tail pages never commit, so oversizing
    96: // costs address space only.
    97: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL char8* c_space_allocate(CSpellingSpace* space, u64 size)
    98: {
    99:     if (space->arena)
   100:     {
   101:         char8* result = (char8*)arena_allocate_bytes(space->arena, size, 1);
   102:         space->used = (u64)(result - space->base) + size;
   103:         BUSTER_VALIDATE(space->used <= UINT32_MAX);
   104:         return result;
   105:     }
   106:     BUSTER_VALIDATE(space->used + size <= space->capacity);
   107:     char8* result = space->base + space->used;
   108:     space->used += size;
   109:     return result;
   110: }
   111: // Hand back the tail of the space's most recent allocation.
   112: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_space_shrink(CSpellingSpace* space, u64 size)
   113: {
   114:     space->used -= size;
   115:     if (space->arena)
   116:     {
   117:         arena_set_position(space->arena, space->arena->position - size);
   118:     }
   119: }
   120: 
   121: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_space_offset(CSpellingSpace const* space, char8 const* pointer)
   122: {
   123:     return (u32)(pointer - space->base);
   124: }
   125: 
   126: // Exact byte length of the literal spelling starting at `spelling`:
   127: // optional encoding prefix, opening delimiter, escape-aware body, closing
   128: // delimiter. The body loop mirrors the lexer's literal scan byte for byte —
   129: // escape pairs skip two — so a spelling the lexer closed re-measures to the
   130: // same length. `limit` bounds the scan for creation-time validation of a
   131: // possibly unterminated spelling; a validated spelling passes UINT64_MAX
   132: // because its closing delimiter, the spelling's own last byte, stops the
   133: // scan. Returns 0 when no delimiter opens at the start.
   134: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u64 c_token_literal_scan_length(char8 const* spelling, u64 limit)
   135: {
   136:     u64 cursor = 0;
   137:     char8 delimiter = 0;
   138:     if (limit && (spelling[0] == '"' || spelling[0] == '\''))
   139:     {
   140:         delimiter = spelling[0];
   141:         cursor = 1;
   142:     }
   143:     else if (limit >= 3 && spelling[0] == 'u' && spelling[1] == '8' && (spelling[2] == '"' || spelling[2] == '\''))
   144:     {
   145:         delimiter = spelling[2];
   146:         cursor = 3;
   147:     }
   148:     else if (limit >= 2 && (spelling[0] == 'u' || spelling[0] == 'U' || spelling[0] == 'L') && (spelling[1] == '"' || spelling[1] == '\''))
   149:     {
   150:         delimiter = spelling[1];

  4985:         }
  4986:         else if (spelling.pointer[1] == 'b' || spelling.pointer[1] == 'B')
  4987:         {

  4989:             index = 2;

  4999:     bool any = false;

  5004:         if (byte == '\'')

  5007:             // suffix. Checking the next byte also rejects consecutive quotes.
  5008:             valid = any && index + 1 < spelling.length && c_integer_digit(spelling.pointer[index + 1]) < base;
  5009:             index += 1;
  5010:         }
  5011:         else
  5012:         {
  5013:             u32 digit = c_integer_digit(byte);
  5014:             if (digit >= base)
  5015:             {
  5016:                 break;
  5017:             }
  5018:             valid = parsed < cutoff || (parsed == cutoff && digit <= last_digit);
  5019:             if (valid)
  5020:             {
  5021:                 parsed = parsed * base + digit;
  5022:                 any = true;
  5023:                 index += 1;
  5024:             }
  5025:         }
  5026:     }
  5027:     valid = valid && any && c_integer_suffix_valid((String8){.pointer = spelling.pointer + index, .length = spelling.length - index});
  5028:     if (valid)
  5029:     {
  5030:         *value = parsed;
  5031:     }
  5032:     return valid;
  5033: }

  5035: // C11 6.10.1p4: conditional-inclusion arithmetic uses intmax_t or
  5036: // uintmax_t. Keep signedness and deferred arithmetic faults in the existing
  5037: // one-byte-per-value sidecar. Reductions still validate every operand's syntax,
  5038: // but &&, || and ?: discard faults from operands they do not evaluate.
  5039: // A fault always follows an evaluated condition/left operand, even when its
  5040: // placeholder value makes a later logical expression appear to succeed.
  5041: enum
  5042: {
  5043:     C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED = 1,
  5044:     C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT = 2,
  5045: };
  5046: 
  5047: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_conditional_apply(CConditionalOperator operation, u64* values, u8* value_flags, u32* value_count)
  5048: {
  5049:     bool valid = true;
  5050:     if (c_conditional_is_unary(operation))
  5051:     {
  5052:         if (!*value_count)
  5053:         {
  5054:             valid = false;
  5055:         }
  5056:         else
  5057:         {
  5058:             u32 index = *value_count - 1;
  5059:             u64* value = values + index;
  5060:             switch (operation)
  5061:             {
  5062:             case C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_PLUS:
  5063:                 break;
  5064:             case C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS:
  5065:                 *value = 0 - *value;
  5066:                 break;
  5067:             case C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_NOT:
  5068:                 *value = !*value;
  5069:                 value_flags[index] &= C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT;
  5070:                 break;
  5071:             case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT:
  5072:                 *value = ~*value;
  5073:                 break;
  5074:             default:
  5075:                 valid = false;
  5076:                 break;
  5077:             }
  5078:         }
  5079:     }
  5080:     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_SELECT)
  5081:     {
  5082:         if (*value_count < 3)
  5083:         {
  5084:             valid = false;
  5085:         }
  5086:         else
  5087:         {
  5088:             u64 false_value = values[--*value_count];
  5089:             u8 false_flags = value_flags[*value_count];
  5090:             u64 true_value = values[--*value_count];
  5091:             u8 true_flags = value_flags[*value_count];
  5092:             u32 index = *value_count - 1;
  5093:             u64* condition = values + index;
  5094:             u8 selected_flags = *condition ? true_flags : false_flags;
  5095:             // Both arms determine the common type, but only the selected
  5096:             // arm and the always-evaluated condition contribute faults.
  5097:             value_flags[index] = (u8)(((true_flags | false_flags) & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED) |
  5098:                                      ((value_flags[index] | selected_flags) & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT));
  5099:             *condition = *condition ? true_value : false_value;
  5100:         }
  5101:     }
  5102:     else if (*value_count < 2)
  5103:     {
  5104:         valid = false;
  5105:     }
  5106:     else
  5107:     {
  5108:         u64 right = values[--*value_count];
  5109:         u8 right_flags = value_flags[*value_count];
  5110:         u32 index = *value_count - 1;
  5111:         u64* left = values + index;
  5112:         u8 left_flags = value_flags[index];
  5113:         u8 flags = (u8)(left_flags | right_flags);
  5114:         bool mixed_unsigned = (flags & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED) != 0;
  5115:         switch (operation)
  5116:         {
  5117:         case C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY:
  5118:             *left *= right;
  5119:             break;
  5120:         case C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE:
  5121:         case C_CONDITIONAL_REMAINDER:
  5122:             // Never execute an invalid host division, even in a subtree
  5123:             // whose fault will be discarded by an enclosing short circuit.
  5124:             if ((flags & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT) || !right ||
  5125:                 (!mixed_unsigned && (s64)*left == INT64_MIN && (s64)right == -1))
  5126:             {
  5127:                 flags |= C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT;
  5128:                 *left = 0;
  5129:             }
  5130:             else if (mixed_unsigned)
  5131:             {
  5132:                 *left = operation == C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE ? *left / right : *left % right;
  5133:             }
  5134:             else
  5135:             {
  5136:                 *left = operation == C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE ? (u64)((s64)*left / (s64)right) : (u64)((s64)*left % (s64)right);

  5511:                                                   : options->target.cpu_arch == CPU_ARCH_BPFEL

  5513:                                                             string_equal(argument, S8("ebpf"))
  5514:                                                       : string_equal(argument, S8("x86_64")))
  5515:                         : is_target_os          ? c_conditional_target_os_supported(options->target.os, argument)
  5516:                         : is_target_vendor      ? (options->target.os == OPERATING_SYSTEM_MACOS || options->target.os == OPERATING_SYSTEM_IOS) &&
  5517:                                                       string_equal(argument, S8("apple"))
  5518:                         : is_target_environment ? false
  5519:                                                 : false;
  5520:         }
  5521:         else if (!has_feature)
  5522:         {
  5523:             return false;
  5524:         }
  5525:         node->token.token.kind = C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER;
  5526:         node->token.token.punctuator = C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE;
  5527:         node->token.token.offset = supported ? C_SPELLING_ONE : C_SPELLING_ZERO;
  5528:         node->token.token.length = 1;
  5529:         node->token.token.symbol = 0;
  5530:         node->next = close->next;
  5531:     }
  5532:     return true;
  5533: }

  5535: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_integer_expression_evaluate_with_features(Arena* arena, CSpellingSpace* space, CSymbolTable* symbols, CMacro* first_macro,
  5536:                                                                      CPpStampTable* stamps, CPpToken* tokens, u32 token_count, u32 expansion_limit,
  5537:                                                                      CPreprocessResult* result,
  5538:                                                                      CPreprocessOptions* options, String8 including_path,
  5539:                                                                      CIncludeSearchOrigin including_origin, u64* value_out)
  5540: {
  5541:     bool valid = true;
  5542:     char8 const* base = space->base;
  5543:     CPpToken* transformed = arena_allocate(arena, CPpToken, token_count);
  5544:     u32 transformed_count = 0;
  5545:     for (u32 token_index = 0; valid && token_index < token_count; token_index += 1)
  5546:     {
  5547:         CPpToken token = tokens[token_index];
  5548:         if (token.token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_spelling_equal(base, token.token, S8("defined")))
  5549:         {
  5550:             u32 name_index = token_index + 1;
  5551:             bool parenthesized = name_index < token_count && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[name_index].token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS);
  5552:             name_index += parenthesized;
  5553:             if (name_index >= token_count || tokens[name_index].token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
  5554:             {
  5555:                 valid = false;
  5556:             }
  5557:             else
  5558:             {
  5559:                 CMacro* macro = c_macro_find_token(first_macro, symbols, base, &tokens[name_index].token);
  5560:                 CPpToken replacement = token;
  5561:                 replacement.token.kind = C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER;
  5562:                 replacement.token.punctuator = C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE;
  5563:                 replacement.token.offset = macro && macro->definition.defined ? C_SPELLING_ONE : C_SPELLING_ZERO;
  5564:                 replacement.token.length = 1;
  5565:                 replacement.token.symbol = 0;
  5566:                 transformed[transformed_count++] = replacement;
  5567:                 token_index = name_index;
  5568:                 if (parenthesized)
  5569:                 {
  5570:                     valid = token_index + 1 < token_count && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[token_index + 1].token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
  5571:                     token_index += 1;
  5572:                 }
  5573:             }
  5574:         }
  5575:         else
  5576:         {
  5577:             transformed[transformed_count++] = token;
  5578:         }
  5579:     }
  5580:     CPreprocessTokenNode* first_expanded = 0;
  5581:     CPreprocessTokenNode* last_expanded = 0;
  5582:     u64 expanded_count = 0;
  5583:     if (valid)
  5584:     {
  5585:         valid = c_preprocess_expand(arena, space, symbols, first_macro, 0, 0, stamps, transformed, transformed_count, &first_expanded,
  5586:                                     &last_expanded, &expanded_count, expansion_limit, result);
  5587:     }
  5588:     if (valid)
  5589:     {
  5590:         valid = c_conditional_feature_operators(arena, space, symbols, first_macro, first_expanded, options, including_path, including_origin);
  5591:     }
  5592:     if (valid)
  5593:     {
  5594:         u64* values = arena_allocate(arena, u64, expanded_count + 1);
  5595:         u8* value_flags = arena_allocate(arena, u8, expanded_count + 1);
  5596:         CConditionalOperator* operations = arena_allocate(arena, CConditionalOperator, expanded_count + 1);
  5597:         u32 value_count = 0;
  5598:         u32 operation_count = 0;
  5599:         bool expect_operand = true;
  5600:         for (CPreprocessTokenNode* node = first_expanded; valid && node; node = node->next)
  5601:         {
  5602:             CToken token = node->token.token;
  5603:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
  5604:             {
  5605:                 u64 value = 0;
  5606:                 String8 number_spelling = c_token_spelling(base, token);
  5607:                 valid = expect_operand && c_conditional_number(number_spelling, &value);
  5608:                 if (valid)
  5609:                 {
  5610:                     // The literal is uintmax_t when it says so or when its
  5611:                     // value does not fit intmax_t. Characters and keywords
  5612:                     // below remain signed regardless of their bit patterns.
  5613:                     bool literal_unsigned = value > (u64)INT64_MAX;
  5614:                     for (u64 suffix_index = 0; suffix_index < number_spelling.length; suffix_index += 1)
  5615:                     {
  5616:                         literal_unsigned |= number_spelling.pointer[suffix_index] == 'u' || number_spelling.pointer[suffix_index] == 'U';
  5617:                     }
  5618:                     value_flags[value_count] = literal_unsigned ? C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED : 0;
  5619:                     values[value_count++] = value;
  5620:                     expect_operand = false;
  5621:                 }
  5622:             }
  5623:             else if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_CHARACTER_LITERAL)
  5624:             {
  5625:                 u64 character = 0;
  5626:                 CTypeKind character_kind = C_TYPE_INVALID;
  5627:                 valid = expect_operand && c_ir_decode_character_value(arena, base, token, result->target, &character, &character_kind);
  5628:                 if (valid)
  5629:                 {
  5630:                     value_flags[value_count] = 0;
  5631:                     values[value_count++] = character;
  5632:                     expect_operand = false;
  5633:                 }
  5634:             }
  5635:             else if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
  5636:             {
  5637:                 valid = expect_operand;
  5638:                 if (valid)
  5639:                 {
  5640:                     value_flags[value_count] = 0;
  5641:                     values[value_count++] = c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(result->dialect) && c_token_spelling_equal(base, token, S8("true"));
  5642:                     expect_operand = false;
  5643:                 }
  5644:             }
  5645:             else if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR)
  5646:             {
  5647:                 valid = false;
  5648:             }
  5649:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
  5650:             {
  5651:                 valid = expect_operand;
  5652:                 if (valid)
  5653:                 {
  5654:                     operations[operation_count++] = C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN;
  5655:                 }
  5656:             }
  5657:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
  5658:             {
  5659:                 valid = !expect_operand;
  5660:                 while (valid && operation_count && operations[operation_count - 1] != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN)
  5661:                 {
  5662:                     valid = c_conditional_apply(operations[--operation_count], values, value_flags, &value_count);
  5663:                 }
  5664:                 valid = valid && operation_count != 0;
  5665:                 if (valid)
  5666:                 {
  5667:                     operation_count -= 1;
  5668:                 }
  5669:             }
  5670:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_QUESTION))
  5671:             {
  5672:                 valid = !expect_operand;
  5673:                 u32 precedence = c_conditional_precedence(C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION);
  5674:                 while (valid && operation_count && operations[operation_count - 1] != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN &&
  5675:                        c_conditional_precedence(operations[operation_count - 1]) > precedence)
  5676:                 {
  5677:                     valid = c_conditional_apply(operations[--operation_count], values, value_flags, &value_count);
  5678:                 }
  5679:                 if (valid)
  5680:                 {
  5681:                     operations[operation_count++] = C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION;
  5682:                     expect_operand = true;
  5683:                 }
  5684:             }
  5685:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_COLON))
  5686:             {
  5687:                 valid = !expect_operand;
  5688:                 while (valid && operation_count && operations[operation_count - 1] != C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION)
  5689:                 {
  5690:                     CConditionalOperator previous = operations[--operation_count];
  5691:                     valid = previous != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN && c_conditional_apply(previous, values, value_flags, &value_count);
  5692:                 }
  5693:                 valid = valid && operation_count != 0;
  5694:                 if (valid)
  5695:                 {
  5696:                     operations[operation_count - 1] = C_CONDITIONAL_SELECT;
  5697:                     expect_operand = true;
  5698:                 }
  5699:             }
  5700:             else
  5701:             {
  5702:                 CConditionalOperator operation = C_CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR_COUNT;
  5703:                 valid = c_conditional_operator(token, expect_operand, &operation);
  5704:                 bool unary = c_conditional_is_unary(operation);
  5705:                 valid = valid && expect_operand == unary;
  5706:                 u32 precedence = c_conditional_precedence(operation);
  5707:                 while (valid && operation_count && operations[operation_count - 1] != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN)
  5708:                 {
  5709:                     CConditionalOperator previous = operations[operation_count - 1];
  5710:                     u32 previous_precedence = c_conditional_precedence(previous);
  5711:                     if (previous_precedence < precedence || (unary && previous_precedence == precedence))
  5712:                     {
  5713:                         break;
  5714:                     }
  5715:                     operation_count -= 1;
  5716:                     valid = c_conditional_apply(previous, values, value_flags, &value_count);
  5717:                 }
  5718:                 if (valid)
  5719:                 {
  5720:                     operations[operation_count++] = operation;
  5721:                     expect_operand = true;
  5722:                 }
  5723:             }
  5724:         }
  5725:         valid = valid && !expect_operand;
  5726:         while (valid && operation_count)
  5727:         {
  5728:             CConditionalOperator operation = operations[--operation_count];
  5729:             valid = operation != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN && operation != C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION &&
  5730:                     c_conditional_apply(operation, values, value_flags, &value_count);
  5731:         }
  5732:         valid = valid && value_count == 1 && !(value_flags[0] & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT);
  5733:         if (valid)
  5734:         {
  5735:             *value_out = values[0];
  5736:         }
  5737:     }
  5738:     return valid;
  5739: }
  5740: 
  5741: // The parse-side entry point: no macro table, so expansion is a pass-through
  5742: // and nothing ever allocates spelling bytes — the read-only space view over
  5743: // the finished result is enough, and any allocation attempt fails loudly.
  5744: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_integer_expression_evaluate(Arena* arena, char8 const* spelling_base, CToken* tokens, u32 token_count, u32 expansion_limit,
  5745:                                                        CPreprocessResult* result, u64* value_out)
  5746: {
  5747:     CSpellingSpace view = {
  5748:         .base = (char8*)spelling_base,
  5749:     };
  5750:     CPpToken* wrapped = arena_allocate(arena, CPpToken, token_count);
  5751:     for (u32 token_index = 0; token_index < token_count; token_index += 1)
  5752:     {
  5753:         wrapped[token_index] = (CPpToken){
  5754:             .token = tokens[token_index],
  5755:         };
  5756:     }
  5757:     return c_integer_expression_evaluate_with_features(arena, &view, 0, 0, 0, wrapped, token_count, expansion_limit, result, 0, (String8){0},
  5758:                                                        (CIncludeSearchOrigin){0}, value_out);
  5759: }
  5760: 
  5761: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_conditional_evaluate(Arena* arena, CSpellingSpace* space, CSymbolTable* symbols, CMacro* first_macro, CPpStampTable* stamps,
  5762:                                                 CPpToken* tokens, u32 token_count, u32 expansion_limit, CPreprocessResult* result, CPreprocessOptions options,
  5763:                                                 String8 including_path, CIncludeSearchOrigin including_origin, bool* value_out)
  5764: {
  5765:     u64 value = 0;
  5766:     bool valid =
  5767:         c_integer_expression_evaluate_with_features(arena, space, symbols, first_macro, stamps, tokens, token_count, expansion_limit, result, &options, including_path,
  5768:                                                     including_origin, &value);
  5769:     *value_out = value != 0;
  5770:     return valid;
  5771: }
  5772: 
  5773: typedef struct CConditionalFrame CConditionalFrame;
  5774: struct CConditionalFrame
  5775: {
  5776:     CConditionalFrame* previous;
  5777:     CSourceLocation location;
  5778:     bool parent_active;
  5779:     bool active;
  5780:     bool branch_taken;
  5781:     bool else_seen;
  5782: };
  5783: 
  5784: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_preprocess_is_active(CConditionalFrame* conditional)
  5785: {
  5786:     return !conditional || conditional->active;
  5787: }
  5788: 
  5789: // The row scan the mask projection below replaces, kept as the definition of
  5790: // a line's end for a run that carries no shape sidecar and as the reference
  5791: // c_test_pp_class_masks_agree holds the mask path to.
  5792: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u64 c_preprocess_line_end(CLexResult lex, u64 token_index)
  5793: {
  5794:     while (token_index < lex.token_count && lex.tokens[token_index].kind != C_TOKEN_NEWLINE && lex.tokens[token_index].kind != C_TOKEN_END_OF_FILE)
  5795:     {
  5796:         token_index += 1;
  5797:     }
  5798:     return token_index;
  5799: }
  5800: 
  5801: // The per-64-token class projection of one lexed run, built once when the run
  5802: // becomes a source frame and read by every per-line scan of the driver below.
  5803: //
  5804: // Every one of those scans asks the same closed set of questions of a token —
  5805: // does the line end here, is this a parenthesis, can this name a macro — and
  5806: // the one-byte shape sidecar answers all of them without touching a 12-byte
  5807: // row, so 64 tokens are one masked load and four compares. What that buys is
  5808: // not the compare but the advance: a line end becomes a trailing-zero count
  5809: // instead of a nine-step row loop with a mispredicted exit, and the
  5810: // parenthesis and macro-name scans visit only the lanes that can answer
  5811: // (12% and 20% of the stream on this workload) instead of every token of
  5812: // every line. C_TOKEN_INVALID is 0, so the masked tail lanes of the last
  5813: // window match no class and need no separate trim.
  5814: #define C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW 64
  5815: 
  5816: typedef struct CPpClassMasks CPpClassMasks;
  5817: struct CPpClassMasks
  5818: {
  5819:     Mask64* stop;
  5820:     Mask64* identifier;
  5821:     Mask64* parenthesis_left;
  5822:     Mask64* parenthesis_right;
  5823:     // 0 when the run carried no shape sidecar; every consumer falls back to
  5824:     // the row scans above on that run.
  5825:     u64 word_count;
  5826: };
  5827: 
  5828: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_pp_class_masks_build(Arena* arena, CPpClassMasks* masks, CTokenShape const* shapes, u64 token_count)
  5829: {
  5830:     u64 word_count = (token_count + (C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW - 1)) / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW;
  5831:     *masks = (CPpClassMasks){0};
  5832:     if (shapes && word_count)
  5833:     {
  5834:         masks->stop = arena_allocate(arena, Mask64, word_count);
  5835:         masks->identifier = arena_allocate(arena, Mask64, word_count);
  5836:         masks->parenthesis_left = arena_allocate(arena, Mask64, word_count);
  5837:         masks->parenthesis_right = arena_allocate(arena, Mask64, word_count);
  5838:         Simd512 newline_shape = simd512_splat((u8)C_TOKEN_NEWLINE);
  5839:         Simd512 end_shape = simd512_splat((u8)C_TOKEN_END_OF_FILE);
  5840:         Simd512 identifier_shape = simd512_splat((u8)C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER);
  5841:         Simd512 left_shape = simd512_splat(c_token_shape_from_fields(C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS));
  5842:         Simd512 right_shape = simd512_splat(c_token_shape_from_fields(C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS));
  5843:         for (u64 word_index = 0; word_index < word_count; word_index += 1)
  5844:         {
  5845:             u64 window_base = word_index * C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW;
  5846:             Mask64 window_mask = mask64_prefix(token_count - window_base);
  5847:             Simd512 window = simd512_load_masked(shapes + window_base, window_mask);
  5848:             masks->stop[word_index] = mask64_or(simd512_equal_byte(window, newline_shape), simd512_equal_byte(window, end_shape));
  5849:             masks->identifier[word_index] = simd512_equal_byte(window, identifier_shape);
  5850:             masks->parenthesis_left[word_index] = simd512_equal_byte(window, left_shape);
  5851:             masks->parenthesis_right[word_index] = simd512_equal_byte(window, right_shape);
  5852:         }
  5853:         masks->word_count = word_count;
  5854:     }
  5855: }
  5856: 
  5857: // The lanes of `word_index` that lie in [first, end): the whole word except
  5858: // at the two ends of the range.
  5859: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL Mask64 c_pp_class_range_mask(u64 word_index, u64 first, u64 end)
  5860: {
  5861:     Mask64 result = mask64_not(0);
  5862:     if (word_index == first / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW)
  5863:     {
  5864:         result = mask64_and(result, mask64_shift_left(mask64_not(0), first % C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW));
  5865:     }
  5866:     if (word_index == (end - 1) / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW)
  5867:     {

  8263:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT16_EPSILON__", S8("9.765625e-4F16"));
  8264:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT16_MAX_EXP__", S8("16"));
  8265:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT16_MIN_EXP__", S8("(-13)"));
  8266:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT16_MAX_10_EXP__", S8("4"));
  8267:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT16_MIN_10_EXP__", S8("(-4)"));
  8268:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT16_HAS_DENORM__", S8("1"));
  8269:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT16_HAS_INFINITY__", S8("1"));
  8270:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT16_HAS_QUIET_NAN__", S8("1"));
  8271:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__SIZEOF_FLOAT16__", string_format(arena, S8("{u32}"), layout.float16_type.size));
  8272:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__SIZEOF_DOUBLE__", string_format(arena, S8("{u32}"), layout.double_type.size));
  8273:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__SIZEOF_LONG_DOUBLE__", string_format(arena, S8("{u32}"), layout.long_double_type.size));
  8274:     // The hosted <float.h> supplied by Clang/GCC spells DBL_EPSILON in terms
  8275:     // of this predefined macro.  Keep the value in the compiler's prelude so
  8276:     // an otherwise ordinary system header does not depend on a host compiler
  8277:     // having supplied it first (cJSON uses DBL_EPSILON directly).
  8278:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__DBL_EPSILON__", S8("2.220446049250313080847263336181640625e-16"));
  8279:     // Lua's number formatting and conversion code queries the corresponding
  8280:     // mantissa width through <float.h>'s __DBL_MANT_DIG__ spelling.  Keep the
  8281:     // IEEE-754 double contract explicit in the builtin prelude, just as the
  8282:     // epsilon above, so an external resource header cannot leave it undefined.
  8283:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__DBL_MANT_DIG__", S8("53"));
  8284:     // Lua's string formatter also uses the decimal exponent bound from
  8285:     // <float.h>; this is the IEEE-754 binary64 value required by
  8286:     // DBL_MAX_10_EXP on every hosted target currently supported here.
  8287:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__DBL_MAX_10_EXP__", S8("308"));
  8288:     // C99's decimal-roundtrip precision macros are exposed by <float.h> in
  8289:     // terms of the compiler predefined spellings.  Keep the IEEE-754 values
  8290:     // in the prelude so external headers (and yyjson's number tests) do not
  8291:     // inherit a host compiler's macro set.
  8292:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT_DECIMAL_DIG__", S8("9"));
  8293:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__DBL_DECIMAL_DIG__", S8("17"));
  8294:     // The rest of the <float.h> vocabulary, with Clang's own spellings: the
  8295:     // hosted header defines every FLT_/DBL_/LDBL_ constant in terms of these
  8296:     // predefines, so a compiler that lacks one turns an ordinary
  8297:     // `double m = DBL_MAX;` into an undeclared identifier -- which is where
  8298:     // CPython's Objects/floatobject.c stopped.  float and double are IEEE
  8299:     // binary32/64 on every hosted target here; the long double family
  8300:     // follows the target's layout below.
  8301:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT_RADIX__", S8("2"));
  8302:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT_MANT_DIG__", S8("24"));
  8303:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT_DIG__", S8("6"));
  8304:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT_MAX__", S8("3.40282347e+38F"));
  8305:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT_NORM_MAX__", S8("3.40282347e+38F"));
  8306:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT_MIN__", S8("1.17549435e-38F"));
  8307:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT_DENORM_MIN__", S8("1.40129846e-45F"));
  8308:     C_DEFINE_TYPE_MACRO("__FLT_EPSILON__", S8("1.19209290e-7F"));
